_comment: Shared fixtures for the payee-key extractor. Read by BOTH tests/test_payee_keys.py (classify.py, the READER) and tests/test_payee_keys.js (bankCorrectionsController.js, the WRITER). They must agree exactly: when they drifted, every stored correction was written under a key the classifier never looked up, and 598 learned Urban Plant entries matched 0 of 261 rows. Each case lists only the identity keys ('exact' is always present and is not asserted here). Every narration below is a real row from a 2026-06 statement.

cases.why: ICICI NEFT: payee sits between the ref and the trailing numeric ids
ICICI NEFT, long escrow label — stable because it repeats verbatim
cases.narration: NEFT-AXISCN1360802861-RAZORPAY PAYMENTS PVT LTD PAYMENT AGGREGATOR ESCROW ACCOUNT -RAZORPAY SOFTWAR

keys.neft_name: razorpay payments pvt ltd payment aggregator escrow account

cases.why: Kotak NEFT: space separated, ref token dropped for carrying digits
cases.narration: NEFT AXISCN1389928147 RAZORPAY PAYMENTS PVT LTD P

cases.why: ICICI netbanking: 4-letter payee AZAD must survive (not an IFSC — no digit run follows)
ICICI bill-pay: single vendor field after the ref
ICICI IMPS: payee precedes the bank name, positional pick
ICICI IMPS, shorter arity — payee still first non-junk field
Kotak UPI: payee first, bank code after
NEGATIVE-ish: 'Bank Account XX' is a placeholder, must be skipped so the real payee is found. Keying on the placeholder collapsed Gaurav/Colonel/LABEL REEBA onto one ledger.
NEGATIVE: NACH mandate ref is concatenated onto the counterparty and changes every instalment (FT6FWSD8 / FT3UYYAU / FSXWJMCE) — emit no key at all
Kotak plain-language transfer rail

NEGATIVE: a bare bank prefix in the payee slot must NOT become a key. Unlike a one-time UTR (unique, therefore inert), a bank code COLLIDES — every narration mentioning that bank would map onto one ledger. Seen in the backfill as 'hdfc' -> HDFC Bank-275.

NEGATIVE-ish: a PURPOSE field sits before the payee on this rail. Keying on 'FEES' collapsed every fee payment onto one ledger (seen live: name 'fees' -> AV Ajmera Ventures). The payee is the field after it.
Same rail with SALARY as the purpose word — payee must win.
REGRESSION GUARD (FLO): slash-NEFT must keep working unchanged
REGRESSION GUARD (FLO): IMPS-FROM must keep working unchanged
HDFC TPT internal transfer — payee is the last field
HDFC NACH loan debit. 28 of these on one Zaydn statement, all previously unkeyable — so every loan row was re-corrected every month and never learned.
cases.narration: ACH D- ADITYA BIRLA FIN LTD-ABNDBIL00000

cases.why: HDFC biller rail — the leading gateway ref changes every txn; the merchant code is the stable half
HDFC merchant rail via Razorpay aggregator
HDFC FT rail — payee is the trailing non-numeric field
cases.narration: FT - DR - 50200021629664 - RAJESHWARI PETROCHEM PRIVATE LIMITED

cases.why: HDFC IMPS dash rail — payee follows the reference
NEFT CR with no '-NETBANK' tail. REGRESSION GUARD for the or-chain bug: spaceNeftPayee returns 'technologies private' (all generic -> rejected) and used to short-circuit the rail that works.
cases.narration: NEFT CR-ICIC0SF0002-BLOCK POOL TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED-ZAYDN-IN42616056652704

cases.why: Fixed-label rail — the narration IS the identity, there is no payee
Merchant prefix before the underscore refs
M Brands manual entry: tag, counterparty, then an invoice reference tail. Without the rail the only key is `exact`, which embeds the invoice numbers and never matches again
same shape with a 'balance' tail — both purpose words must be stripped
tag shape but the payee is 2 chars once the tail is stripped — too ambiguous to be an identity key, so no name is emitted
card terminal: 3rd slash segment is the merchant; the IND* acquirer tag is not identity, and the tail is city+date+time
same, with a parenthetical qualifier that must be dropped
card terminal without an acquirer tag
acquirer-tagged merchant at the tail of a refund narration (not the PCD layout)
cheque clearing: the counterparty's BANK follows their name and is not identity
cases.narration: CLG TO PS WAREHOUSING ENTERPR UNION BANK OF INDIA

cases.why: guard: a payee whose name merely STARTS with a bank word must not be truncated — the bank token only counts when followed by BANK
cases.narration: CLG TO UNION TRADERS PVT LTD
